commands.name: Manage Extensions
commands.description: Install extensions from files or folders, review what is installed

walkthrough.title: Add something Flowkey does not do yet
walkthrough.summary: Install your first extension from a file or folder
walkthrough.body:
Extensions are built on the same API the built-in features use, so anything you install behaves like it shipped with the app — same search, same actions, same keyboard rules.

## To complete the task

Download an extension (.asyar package or unpacked folder) from anywhere, open **Manage Extensions**, and install it.
